The expanded partnership will focus on developing technologies and workflows aimed at accelerating video playback capabilities and supporting Sphere’s
next phase of global growth, the companies said.

“Sphere was built to redefine live entertainment,” Ryan Dolan, executive vice president and head of event and interactive technology at Sphere, said in the statement. He added that artists performing at Sphere
have benefited from Disguise’s technology and that the companies will develop future iterations of immersive productions.

The companies said the technology developed through the partnership will support Sphere’s
expansion while enabling the venue to maintain its position in live entertainment.

Fernando Küfer, CEO of Disguise, said the company is excited to focus on expanding Sphere’s video offerings using its technology and to develop systems capable of supporting new entertainment experiences.
